intensity_columns_used: LFQ intensity H1, LFQ intensity H2, LFQ intensity H3, LFQ intensity L1, LFQ intensity L2, LFQ intensity L3
filtering_rule: kept only protein groups with all six per-sample LFQ intensities present and positive (no missing, no zero); no imputation needed
normalization_method: per-sample quantile normalization in log2 space: each sample's log intensities shifted so its median equals the overall matrix median; appropriate because the constant human fraction makes the majority of groups unchanged
test_method: two-sample Welch t-test on log2 LFQ intensities, H minus L
processing_order: parse -> remove reverse/contaminant/site rows -> require complete positive measurements -> log2 transform -> quantile normalization -> Welch t-test -> BH FDR -> significant at adj_p < 0.05
